messages.content: Write a customer testimonial section for the website of a log aggregation service. Around 200 words.

## What teams say

> "Two a.m., forty boxes, forty grep windows. That was the old routine. When checkout went down in March we found the bad deploy in eleven minutes instead of tailing files until sunrise."
>
> **Priya Raghunathan** — Staff SRE, Wexler Freight

> "I put a whole sprint on the board for the migration and told everyone it was going to be tight. The agent shipped to production on day four. We turned off the old Elasticsearch cluster the next Tuesday and no one has asked to turn it back on."
>
> **Daniel Okonkwo** — Platform Lead, Corvid Health

> "We went from $18k a month to roughly $4,200, and that was while ingesting 30% more. Retention was the part I didn't expect: seven days became ninety. The quarterly fight over which services get to keep their logs is just gone."
>
> **Mireille Fontaine** — Director of Engineering, Halden Systems

> "Support needs a customer's request trace about twice a week. That used to land in my queue as a ticket. They pull it themselves now, and I only hear from them when something is genuinely broken."
>
> **Sam Weatherly** — Backend Engineer, Tessellate

*Names, companies, and figures above are placeholders — swap in real, approved quotes before publishing.*
